content.title: EASA - The Electro•Mechanical Authority
content.text: Explore Careers in the Electromechanical Industry The electromechanical repair industry offers exciting and varied job opportunities for employees that want to be part of an industry that's essential to everyday life. Explore the many technical and non-technical positions in typical service centers! EXPLORE THE CAREERS FIND SERVICE CENTERS NEAR YOU Looking for Employees? If you're a member, EASA has a video and other resources to help promote your business to potential employees. LEARN MORE New in 2025: 72 Enhancements to EASA's AR100 Standard EASA’s “Recommended Practice for the Repair of Rotating Electrical Apparatus” is designated ANSI/EASA AR100 and was first approved as an American National standard in 1998. Since then, it has been revised and approved five more times, in 2001, 2006, 2010, 2015, 2020 and now in 2025. ANSI/EASA AR100 is a must-have guide to the repair of rotating electrical machines. Its purpose is to establish recommended practices in each step of the rotating electrical apparatus rewinding and rebuilding processes. READ MORE & DOWNLOAD BUY PRINTED COPIES New 11-Part Leadership Lab Webinar Series Kicks Off in April 2026 EASA has engaged consulting firm OpX Solutions to conduct a series of leadership development webinars. Like the technical webinar series, the leadership webinars will be recorded and made available at easa.com to ALL interested EASA members at no cost thanks to our sponsors. The series includes a strong ROI-based approach to support members in achieving their goals and recognizing measurable results - in business and personal goals. Each session is designed to stand alone, though they build upon topics in previous webinars. Foundational Principles (Sessions 1-3): Build your leadership foundation Personal Leadership (Sessions 4-5): Strengthen your self-leadership Motivational Leadership (Sessions 6-11): Master leading and developing others This is a great opportunity for up-and-coming supervisors and leaders as well as those who are experienced!
